flow: ui-path — navigate to /search/<q> and read the JS-rendered result grid

steps.note: VERIFIED 2026-09-20: /search/موزیک rendered 60 a[href*='/v/'] anchors; /search/طنز rendered 58. Title becomes '<q> | آپارات سرویس اشتراک ویدیو'. Result hrefs carry ?discovery=1 / ?refererRef=search query suffixes — strip to the bare /v/<id>.
VERIFIED — each video appears as TWO anchors (thumbnail-anchor with img.alt=duration like '2:03:10', title-anchor with real text); dedupe by /v/<id> and skip duration-only strings.

VERIFIED — anchors appear ~7–10s after domcontentloaded (SPA hydration); readyState alone is NOT enough. Header search input is input[name='search'] (id 'search-input' on search pages, placeholder 'جستجوی ویدیو در آپارات') — typing + Enter navigates to /search/<q> via the site's own JS (VERIFIED live).

rpc: none captured — the site's internal search API (under /api/fa/v1/...) is unmapped (naive probe 400s). Reads happen off the rendered page — no fabricated traffic.
stealth: plain page loads in the user's own browser session — indistinguishable from a human searching; no synthetic requests
